models_evaluated: AI-based ultrasound guidance and remote image review system

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of remote review by reviewer expertise type
links.effect: Radiologist reviewers: sensitivity 90%-95%, specificity 74%-84%, PPV 30%-42%; POCUS-certified EM reviewers: sensitivity 95%-98%, specificity 97%-100%, PPV 81%-100%.
links.quote: Performance is influenced by reviewer expertise.

unlisted_practices: AI-guided image acquisition by non-expert operators (nurses) with remote expert clinician review

links.outcome: Diagnostic sensitivity and specificity by remote reviewer expertise
links.effect: EM reviewer sensitivity was 95%-98% and specificity 97%-100%; radiologist reviewer sensitivity was 90%-95% and specificity 74%-84%.
links.quote: EM reviewer sensitivity ranged from 95%-98%, specificity from 97%-100%, NPV was 99%, PPV from 81%-100%, and potential expert-led ultrasound scans avoided from 29%-38%.

unlisted_practices: Second-reader review and majority voting for interpretation of AI-guided ultrasound scans.

links.effect: EM reviewer specificity ranged from 97%-100% and PPV from 81%-100%, compared to radiologist specificity from 74%-84% and PPV from 30%-42%.
links.quote: Performance is influenced by reviewer expertise.
